acceptance: Every data type and table schema is code in `qlab_data/types.py`; each `tests/contracts/data.*/` sample validates against its schema
Every PL-07 step and contract function imports with its signature, body `raise NotImplementedError("<its task>")`; `qlab_data.testing.write_version` writes a version folder from fixture CSVs
Fakes of `data.open_loader`, `data.trading_days`, `data.resolve_version` and `data.list_versions` serve the samples
Every builder type is code in `qlab_builder/types.py`, one sample each; boundary samples in `tests/contracts/builder.*/` validate
Every PL-04 step imports with its signature, body `raise NotImplementedError("<its task>")`; `__init__.py` exports the contract
Every M1 response model is Pydantic code in `qlab_server/models`; each `tests/contracts/server.*/` sample validates against it
Every PL-08 and PL-10 step imports with its signature, stubbed; the exported schema is written to `packages/web/src/api/openapi.json`
`api/generated.ts` is generated from `openapi.json`; `tsc` passes; `web.Page` and each PL-11 step are typed stubs throwing `"<its task>"`
A fixture-backed fake server (mock service worker) answers every `server.*` sample
`begin_run`/`finish_run` write the lock row and events on the samples; a second `begin_run` raises `RunActiveError`
On recorded vendor responses, `download_full` returns a valid `Download`; 3 failures raise `SourceError` naming the request; keys never appear in errors
`save_snapshot` then `read_snapshots` round-trips the `Download` sample into `RawTables`; files are read-only; a changed byte raises `SnapshotTamperedError`
Reads `reference/` seeded from TC-19 and TC-20 into a valid `ReferenceLists` with a stable hash
The `RawTables` sample gives a schema-valid `CanonicalTables`: permaticker IDs, ticker spans, effective-dated membership, every row kept
The `ValidatedDataset` sample gives an `EdaReport` with the summary section that validates against `eda-report.schema.json`
The samples publish a version in `data`'s layout whose fingerprint repeats on a second publish; a failure mid-write leaves the registry untouched
On a `write_version` fixture, the samples give a valid `PriceRows`; flagged rows drop only on request
On the `data.open_loader` fake, `open_cache` selects the default version; `select` switches it and rejects a failed one without `allow_failed`
`build_app` mounts the routers and static bundle; a `DataError` becomes a `Problem` with its `code`
Against the fake server, the hook returns the selected `VersionRow` and switching calls `select_version`
